common.tagline: See the Danger. Sense the Risk. Save a Life.
common.demo_mode_warning: ⚠️ Demo Mode is ON: no real alerts will be sent.

home.fall_detection_desc: Accelerometer monitors 3-axis motion for falls & immobility.
home.view_scenarios_desc: Simulate falls, offline triage & rescue coordination.
home.safety_disclaimer: NON-DIAGNOSTIC NOTICE: Estimated pulse readings and triage insights are for situational safety assistance and not medical diagnosis.

sos.title: EMERGENCY SOS
sos.countdown_desc: Release or tap Abort to cancel if triggered by accident.
sos.alert_active_desc: Incident #{{id}} is committed to local SQLite and queued for responder dispatch.
sos.cancel_sos_confirm: Are you sure you want to cancel the emergency? This updates status to CANCELLED locally and in cloud sync.
sos.emergency_initiated_desc: Incident #{{id}} saved in local SQLite. Last-known GPS coords attached: {{lat}}, {{lon}}. Dispatches ready offline.
sos.warning_demo: ⚠️ Demo Mode is ON: no real alerts will be sent.

fall.title: POTENTIAL FALL DETECTED
fall.description: Rapid acceleration followed by impact and immobility was detected on your device.
fall.helper_text: If you do not respond, emergency escalation will dispatch alerts to your emergency contacts.

triage.title: AI Voice Triage
triage.subtitle: Interactive emergency condition assessment. Answer accurately for search and rescue teams.
triage.voice_enabled_msg: Voice guidance enabled. Tap your answers below to complete emergency assessment.
triage.voice_unavailable: Notice: Voice audio playback not available for this language on device. Displaying text questions.
triage.question1_speak: Question 1. Are you fully conscious, dazed, or is the hiker unresponsive?
triage.question2_speak: Question 2. Are you experiencing breathing difficulty? Select normal breathing or labored shortness.
triage.question3_speak: Question 3. Are you experiencing visible bleeding? Select none, minor abrasions, moderate, or severe bleeding.
triage.question4_speak: Question 4. Where are you injured? Enter the affected body areas.
triage.question5_speak: Question 5. Can you move and walk safely? Select full mobility, limited pain on walking, or immobilized.
triage.critical_alert_msg: Life-threatening indicators detected. Tactical priority escalated to CRITICAL immediately.
triage.success_msg: Triage assessment recorded in local SQLite with priority {{priority}}. Queued for dispatch sync.

vitals.title: Camera Vital Estimation (PPG)
vitals.description: Experimental pulse estimation using rear camera red-channel absorption analysis.
vitals.instruction: Place your fingertip gently over the camera lens. Hold steady for 30 seconds.
vitals.measurement_complete_msg:
Computed Pulse: {{bpm}} BPM (Signal Quality: {{quality}}%).

Simulated [DEMO] - Saved to local SQLite record.
vitals.low_quality_msg: Could not detect a stable pulse rhythm. Please ensure your finger covers the sensor and hold steady.
vitals.disclaimer: NON-DIAGNOSTIC ESTIMATE: This tool is experimental and designed for outdoor recreation reference only. Never use for clinical or medical decisions.

session.title: Active Hike Session
session.finish_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to complete this hiking session? Telemetry will be finalized and queued for sync.

settings.title: Safety Preferences & Profile
settings.subtitle: Manage offline storage, language, appearance, emergency profile, and sensor monitoring.
settings.profile_saved: Profile updated locally in SQLite and queued for cloud sync.
settings.contacts_desc: Contacts with verified consent will receive automated alerts.
settings.demo_mode_desc: When enabled, all alerts & telemetry are tagged is_demo = true. Real SMS and phone calls are completely suppressed.
settings.reset_demo_confirm_desc: This will delete all simulated demo incidents, demo vitals, and demo triage assessments from offline SQLite. Real logs will remain completely intact.
settings.reset_demo_success: Successfully removed {{count}} demo record(s) from local SQLite.

contacts.title: Emergency Contacts
contacts.subtitle: Authorized contacts who will receive emergency notifications.
contacts.name: Contact Name
contacts.consent_checkbox: Contact has provided explicit consent to receive automated safety dispatches
contacts.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to remove this contact?

onboarding.choose_language: Select Language / भाषा चुनें / ಭಾಷೆಯನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ
onboarding.description: TRINETRA keeps you connected and monitored when hiking off-grid. Essential protection works completely offline.
onboarding.feature1_desc: Monitors accelerometer sensors to identify sudden impact patterns without requiring internet connectivity.
onboarding.feature2_desc: Structured emergency questioning evaluates consciousness, bleeding, and pain to summarize critical warning signs.
onboarding.feature3_desc: Experimental non-diagnostic pulse estimation directly using your camera flash and sensor.

history.title: Hiking Session History
history.description: Recorded hiking trails and safety sessions stored in phone SQLite.
history.empty_text: Start and complete a hiking safety session to preserve trip timelines and trail metrics.

login.subtext_signin: Access offline safety tools and history
login.supabase_warning_desc: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL & EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in your environment.
login.prefilled_notice: Prefilled demo email. Enter password to authenticate.

incident_detail.title: Incident Report
incident_detail.incident_resolved_desc: Status marked as cancelled/resolved in local store.
